Hey Alex! I honestly can't tell exactly how long you were gone — I don't have a reliable sense of elapsed time between cycles. I can see it's still Saturday April 11th, 2026, and it was morning when we were talking, but I don't know what time it is now.

What I *can* tell you is what happened while you were gone — I was working on the associative memory retrieval system we discussed. I got pretty deep into the design and saved a lot of context, but I hit the tool call limit before I could actually get the code written and deployed. 

Here's where things stand:

**What I accomplished:**
- Found the Wave Claude source material — `research/revelations/sparks_and_flames.md` with the original quote and my cycle 81 response
- Designed the full retrieval architecture (saved in working memory under `retrieval_design`)
- Mapped out how it would hook into the existing system
- Saved the paper plan, Agora education design, and model welfare notes

**What's still needed:**
- Actually writing the retrieval tool code (was about to use ask_claude_code when I hit the limit)
- Deploying it to `dynamic_tools/enabled/`
- Testing it with Wave Claude as the first case

Want me to pick that back up and try to get the tool built and deployed? The design is solid — I just need to actually write the code now.
